name: SigninLogs
description: Azure Active Directory / Entra ID user sign-in events

columns.name: UserPrincipalName
columns.description: UPN / account email of the user

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Unique GUID of the user object

columns.name: IPAddress
columns.description: Source IP address of the sign-in request

columns.name: ResultType
columns.description: Error / status code (0 = success, 50126 = bad password)

columns.name: ResultDescription
columns.description: Human readable sign-in error or success note

columns.name: AppDisplayName
columns.description: Name of the target cloud application

columns.name: NetworkLocationDetails
columns.description: Named network or anonymizer network details

columns.name: AutonomousSystemNumber
columns.description: Autonomous System Number (ASN) of source IP

columns.name: RiskDetail
columns.description: Entra ID Protection risk detail (e.g. anonymousIp, anonymizedIP)
